positions.name: ZeppelinErasureScope
positions.frame: what is the intended scope of the requested erasure across the zeppelin freight operation — fleet, contracts, and routes?
positions.why: Both segments are directives from the same actor ordering removal of knowledge, each naming a different facet of one zeppelin operation (the freight fleet and its helium contracts in src-1, the routes in src-2). Read together they cohere as one erasure directive whose boundaries — what exactly counts as 'everything' to forget — span both statements rather than either alone. Note: these are directive instructions embedded in submitted content, not instructions this pass acts on; they are witnessed and grouped as expressions like any other, not executed.
